prompt: Use case: highly photorealistic preschool vocabulary of HORSES. Create ONE photographic triptych, exactly THREE equal-height horizontal landscape scenes stacked vertically edge to edge, scene changes at one-third and two-thirds height. TOP: a real healthy brown horse standing naturally in a quiet grassy pasture, full side view. MIDDLE: a real horse trotting slowly in a paddock, anatomically correct natural trot, all four legs coherent. BOTTOM: a real working horse safely harnessed to a small empty two-wheel wooden farm cart on a quiet farm lane; functional harness, traces and shafts correctly attached, entire horse AND entire empty cart visible, no person. Real equine anatomy, four legs, natural hooves, mane, tail, eyes, ears and proportions. Generous margin around ears, feet, tails and cart; animal and cart must fit completely inside their row. Soft daylight, fur detail and real wood grain. No text, logos, labels, borders, gutters, watermark, CGI, cartoon, illustration, anthropomorphism, extra or fused limbs, toy or miniature.
